FIELDS.NAME: Pinnacle Builders & Contractors
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Pinnacle Builders & Contractors specializes in residential new home construction, primarily focusing on owner-occupied properties. We provide a range of services, including kitchen and bathroom renovations, and light commercial tenant improvements under $500,000. Our skilled team ensures all subcontractors are licensed and insured, maintaining strict compliance with safety standards and regulations. Our operations are limited to single-family homes, effectively managing our liability exposure. We pride ourselves on having a solid safety program, preventing injuries on site, and ensuring the security of our tools and equipment, stored in locked trailers when not in use.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Pinnacle Renovations LLC, specializing in residential kitchen and bathroom remodeling services
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and on-site watchpersons to ensure safety and security of equipment and materials.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Our operations do not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. We focus on residential construction and maintain compliance with safety regulations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Pinnacle Builders & Contractors does not sponsor athletic teams. Our focus remains on residential construction and related services.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: Yes – Sub-contractors are required to provide a certificate of insurance before they can work. Our team checks these certificates to ensure compliance and manage potential liabilities.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There has been no indictment or conviction for fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property by any applicant associated with Pinnacle Builders & Contractors.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverages declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. Pinnacle Builders & Contractors maintains a good standing with its insurance carrier.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Pinnacle Builders & Contractors does not lease employees to or from other employers. Our workforce is entirely composed of our own employees.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Pinnacle Builders & Contractors carries Workers Compensation insurance, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements and providing coverage for our employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Pinnacle Builders & Contractors owns and operates another business, Pinnacle Renovations LLC, which specializes in residential kitchen and bathroom remodeling services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Pinnacle Builders & Contractors does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. All necessary coverage is included under the current policy.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Pinnacle Builders & Contractors is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; we solely focus on residential construction and related services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Pinnacle Builders & Contractors does not rent or loan equipment to others as our operations are focused solely on residential construction services for owner-occupied properties. This helps us manage liability and maintain control over our equipment and projects.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Pinnacle Builders & Contractors has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, maintaining a solid financial standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Pinnacle Builders & Contractors does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on residential construction and related services.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Pinnacle Builders & Contractors does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations are solely focused on residential construction and we take measures to manage risks effectively.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Pinnacle Builders & Contractors has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company maintains a strong commitment to compliance and ethical hiring practices.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Pinnacle Builders & Contractors has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all fire safety regulations.
